title: Brugada Announces MXN 40 Billion Renovation of Metro Line 3
detail: Speaking at the newly renovated Universidad station, Jefa de Gobierno Clara Brugada announced a comprehensive rehabilitation of Metro Line 3 — the busiest line after 1 and 2, carrying over 1 million passengers daily across 23 km and 21 stations from Indios Verdes to Universidad — with an investment exceeding MXN 40 billion, more than 18 times the cost of the Line 2 modernization. The five-point plan includes 45 new trains, full track rehabilitation, modernized electrical/electromechanical and fire-protection systems, updated signaling, and rehabilitation of all 21 stations with expanded surveillance and accessibility upgrades. Major works begin in 2027, financed partly through a co-investment scheme with private participation; Brugada guaranteed no station closures or fare increase (still MXN 5) during 2026.

media.caption: Clara Brugada announces MXN 40 billion Metro Line 3 renovation at Universidad station

title: Fiscalía Reports 21% Rise in Extortion Complaints, Names Five Criminal Groups
detail: The Fiscalía General de Justicia de la Ciudad de México (FGJ-CDMX) reported that extortion complaints rose 21% in the first five months of 2026, with 727 investigation files opened versus 599 in the same period of 2025. The report identified La Unión Tepito, Anti Unión, Los Rodolfos, the Tláhuac Cartel, and Los Malcriados 3AD as the groups most linked to the crime, operating across the capital's central, southern, western, eastern, and northern zones. The FGJ said its anti-extortion strategy has produced more than 330 arrests since January 2025.

media.caption: Extortion complaints rise 21% in CDMX; five criminal groups identified

title: SSC-CDMX Arrests Three for Extortion, Sexual Assault and Robbery in GAM/Iztapalapa
detail: The Secretaría de Seguridad Ciudadana (SSC-CDMX) executed three arrest warrants against two men and a woman — identified as Dulce Anahí 'N' among them — accused of extortion, sexual assault, and aggravated robbery in the Gustavo A. Madero and Iztapalapa boroughs. Authorities linked the suspects to a criminal cell operating in the area as part of the ongoing crackdown on extortion networks.

media.caption: SSC-CDMX arrests three for extortion, sexual assault and robbery in GAM/Iztapalapa
